Definition: adverb from G5318; plainly, i.e. clearly or publicly:--evidently, openly.
BiblicalUsage: Phaneros is the adverb plainly, openly, and it marks the moments when what was hidden comes into view. Cornelius sees an angel in a vision evidently about the ninth hour, Jesus goes up to the feast not openly but as it were in secret, and the healed leper spreads the matter abroad so that Jesus can no more openly enter a city.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that openly and secretly are both God's ways: He shows Himself plainly to Cornelius, and He hides His Son from the crowds, and the wisdom is knowing which hour it is.
